verdict.rationale: Ironclad, as evidenced, is a contract lifecycle management platform: contract creation, workflows, signing, storage, APIs and webhooks. Filing state annual reports and franchise tax is registered-agent/entity-compliance work, which falls outside that category, so this is a wrong-axis question rather than a missing feature. The early community mentions of startup legal paperwork concern contractor agreements, not government filings, so they do not make the axis applicable.
